title: polygonum amphibium subvar. hirtuosum
intro: Polygonum amphibium subvar. hirtuosum, commonly known as hairy water pepper or water pepper, is a variety of the Polygonum amphibium plant, which is a perennial aquatic plant native to Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Polygonum amphibium subvar. hirtuosum include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
